title: Shared service chart values
description: Developer interface for deploying one HTTP service. Security, probe timings, rollout, and Service settings are fixed by the chart.

project.description: GCP project ID. First part of resource names and the project label.

environment.description: Deployment environment. Second part of resource names and the namespace.

serviceName.description: Service name. Last part of resource names, the service (cost) label, and SERVICE_NAME.

owner.description: Owning person or team, as a Kubernetes label value.

repository.description: Registry host (optional port) and path, without tag or digest.

digest.description: Registry manifest digest reported after the image is pushed.

releaseVersion.description: Release identifier, as quoted text. Becomes RELEASE_VERSION and the version label.

containerPort.description: Port the application listens on. Ports below 1024 need privileges the chart removes.

replicas.description: Replica bounds for the HorizontalPodAutoscaler, which scales on CPU at 70%. Defaults to 2 and 3 in the chart.

httpRoute.description: Exposes the service at this hostname through the environment's Gateway, and admits only the load balancer's source ranges to its Pods.

secrets.description: Secret Manager secrets mounted read-only. A secret mounts only if Terraform grants it to this service's KSA.

name.description: Secret Manager secret ID, also the file name in the mount directory.

env.description: Environment variable that receives the file path. Must end in _FILE.
